Services

What the studio does

From the price list and from what guests write in their Google reviews.

Manicure and gel

Soft gel, hard gel and nail extensions in several lengths, with French or your own design.

Pedicure with massage

Full spa pedicure, with or without soft gel. Guests write about the short foot massage that comes with it.

Lashes

Lash lift, classic lashes, 2D to 3D volume and mega volume.

Every colour

Guests write about a huge choice of colours, and that the team brings the design they come in with to life.

Recent work

Photos from the studio’s Google listing.

How guests describe a visit

Taken from what guests write in their Google reviews.

Very clean

38 reviews mention how clean the studio and the tools are.

Walk in and ask

Several guests write that they walked in and got a slot the same day, even when the studio was busy. To be sure, book by phone or Instagram.

A family studio

Guests describe it as family run, and one writes about the Vietnamese coffee served during the manicure.

On Stasinou in Skala

The studio is on Stasinou in the Skala area of Larnaca, and guests write that it is easy to get to. Regulars say they have been coming for months, sometimes since last summer, for both hands and feet, and that their nails stay perfect for weeks.

What guests say

Three of 244 Google reviews, all three with five stars.
